notes.title: v0.18.156 - New Look + Whole Lotta Card Fixes / Updates
notes.content:
I've been busy working on bug fixes and a FREE TO PLAY 'Peace Edition' for Bud Masters.  It contains the One of Each mode and no deck builder.  The 'Peace Edition' is PvP compatible with the Early Access 'Battle Edition'.

The idea of the Peace Edition is to not only promote peace (of course), but to allow people to quickly jump into a game and start learning all the cards through playing.

Once people are ready to 'start battling with custom decks' they can always upgrade to the current 'Battle Edition'.  

Why the New Look?   Well the new 'Hippie Free Love' Peace Edition store page was not approved by the new business review team / AI systems at Steam... 

NOT APPROVED:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37302464/0670da29c8117c57b9f8ae482e15b4a31816d10f.png[/img]

Flagged as 'too sexual' + 'not PG-13 safe'...  in the end it came down to the Weed Leaf... but there are other PG-13 Weed Leaf logos / games etc... so instead of getting too attached to endlessly changing the peace sign and weed leaf logo, I started experimenting... 

After a few tokes and feeling in a rebel dark mood and... well, yes, I've completely updated the branding.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37302464/6dfc54be306f8b4ce8bb2cc55d6032b29bc95cf8.png[/img]

I know what I see in my Mind's Eye... and with a ton of prompting (I am using Midjourney at moment)  + a lot of human Photoshop work, colour work and logo work = it looks pretty good??

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37302464/b8ae47a14c81bfbb31d008251c7d959bb7c16e5c.png[/img]

Will see what the Steam Business Team say after another re-submit of the new 'Peace Edition' store page for evaluation.  Hopefully all goes well and the 'Peace Edition' will launch on April 19th - just in time for 420!   

[h2]'Battle Edition' Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] ABILITY FIX: swap card owner - fixed replication - fixes a lot of odd behavior when cards were 'swapping owner' such as with 'The Retriever' / 'The Dance Floor' / 'The Lava Lamp' etc.
[*] CARD PARTIAL FIX: 'Soul Sacrifice' - fixed ability + sent to graveyard (still bug when revived from graveyard = retains kill ability but icon is not showing...)

[*] DECK BUILDER: some ui clean up - more to come!
[*] UI / UX / GRAPHICS: slowly polishing the UI with the help of AI + my Photoshop skillz (lol) - more to come!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37302464/f4cf10ec5f68c7e1d4a19b505ac21b17fbdd166d.png[/img]

[h2]COMING ASAP![/h2]
[list]
[*] NEW CARD: 'Mobile Phone' - 'wastes your time' - lifestyle, hindering card, taunt protect all player cards + bud bowl until dealt with... 
[*] NEW CARD: 'Grave Robber' - 'the other oldest profession' - take the top card from your opponent graveyard and add it to your hand
